title: Vietnamese Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry made with chicken, a blend of Vietnamese spices, and a rich coconut milk sauce. Serve over steamed rice for a satisfying and delicious meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the curry powder to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the fish sauce, sugar, and chicken broth to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pan and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve over steamed rice.
